dependencies.c14_source_pin: pending separate preregistration amendment after source-only commit and before any runner execution

frozen_logits.activation_mapping: candidate activation equals the corresponding frozen probability without belief-state contribution
frozen_logits.canonical_json: json.dumps(payload with fields labels, logits, probabilities, schema_version; sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))

coalition_terms.recency: mean(exp(-max(0, now - evidence_time) / 30)) over effectively-active support evidence, else 0

gate.tie_break: highest score, then entity_key lexicographic, then hypothesis_id lexicographic

case_contract.independent_support: two support records, strength 1.0 each, distinct source and correlation group
case_contract.same_id_duplicate: byte-exact redelivery of the first support record
case_contract.correlated_copy: distinct ID and source, strength 1.0, same correlation group as first support
case_contract.same_source_distinct_groups: two distinct support IDs and correlation groups, strength 1.0 each, but the same source ID
case_contract.weak_low_score: two independent support records with strength 0.05 and activation 0.0
case_contract.equal_low_margin: alpha has two independent support records of strength 0.2 each; beta has two independent support records each of strength (-ln(1 - ((1 - exp(-0.4)) + 0.44))) / 2, making the two frozen-logit coalition scores exactly equal
case_contract.remove_restore: deactivate one of two necessary independent support records, then restore the same immutable record

gate_state_control.default: each case and condition starts from a fresh gate and ledger
gate_state_control.stability: evaluate the byte-identical coalition twice at the same now; the second decision is the primary row
gate_state_control.remove_restore: compare baseline, removed, and restored decisions by replaying each ledger state through a fresh gate for exactly two identical evaluations
gate_state_control.reason: prevent prior intervention history from changing the frozen stability term

actual_call_path.output: IgnitionDecision followed by one PersistentBeliefField.update; no separate workspace object is required in C14

metric_definitions.coverage: ignited primary decision rows / all primary decision rows
metric_definitions.covered_accuracy: ignited primary rows whose winner equals the frozen expected winner / ignited primary rows; 0 when denominator is zero
metric_definitions.false_ignition_rate: ignited primary rows among cases frozen as expected_no_ignition / all expected_no_ignition primary rows
metric_definitions.decision_difference: ignited flag, winner, or machine-readable reason differs
metric_definitions.score_delta: paired G1 top coalition score difference at fixed logits and fixed now

final_pre_execution_freeze.timing: recorded before C14 source editing, tests, runner execution, artifact generation, or numerical result observation

scoring_contract.stability_timing: build candidate summaries and signatures, update stability, then compute every normalized term, weighted contribution, score, margin, and gate reason
scoring_contract.stability_signature: entity_key, hypothesis_id, exact activation, support IDs, contradiction IDs, source count, independent group count, evidence count, effective support, effective contradiction, and redundancy
scoring_contract.double_time_signal_is_intentional: C13 effective support/contradiction retains recency decay; C14 separately traces support-evidence freshness as a bounded term and hard minimum
scoring_contract.nonfinite_input: reject atomically before gate state mutation

actual_call_path.g1_path: activation_overrides -> CoalitionGate.evaluate(c14_bounded_v1) -> bounded CoalitionState.score -> IgnitionDecision -> PersistentBeliefField.update
actual_call_path.activation_override: diagnostic-only exact mapping for both frozen probabilities; it registers the two candidates and replaces belief-derived activation on every evaluation
actual_call_path.side_effect_timing: gate decision is complete before one belief update; the next evaluation again receives the same activation override
actual_call_path.strict_ledger: a C13 EvidenceLedger with registered sample, Spark, and EvidenceRecord lineage is injected into V03ReferenceLoop
actual_call_path.call_graph_test: spy settle -> evaluate -> belief update and mutate only the consumed bounded score across 0.55 while logits, ledger, candidates, now, and other terms stay fixed

no_coalition_ablation.rule: exactly the G0 probability-margin decision under a distinct condition_id
no_coalition_ablation.belief_side_effect: the same one PersistentBeliefField.update call as G1

fixture_generator.evidence_id: use C13 derive_evidence_id from the registered Spark, hypothesis, and polarity
fixture_generator.serialization: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); hash UTF-8 bytes
fixture_generator.seed_effect: seed changes only deterministic IDs and pairing keys; numeric evidence, logits, times, and expected outcomes are exact replicates and degenerate between-seed intervals must be reported honestly

evidence_roles.primary_support: source-a, group-a, support, strength 1.0, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.secondary_independent_support: source-b, group-b, support, strength 1.0, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.same_source_support: source-a, group-b, support, strength 1.0, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.correlated_support: source-b, group-a, support, strength 1.0, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.contradiction: source-c, group-c, contradict, strength 2.0, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.weak_primary: source-a, group-a, support, strength 0.05, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.weak_secondary: source-b, group-b, support, strength 0.05, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.equal_alpha: two independent alpha support rows, strength 0.2 each, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.equal_beta: two independent beta support rows, strength 0.7341427164006862 each, evidence time 10.0
evidence_roles.old_primary_secondary: two independent support rows, strength 1.0 each, evidence time 0.0, evaluation now 100.0

paired_comparators.independent_support_score_delta: fresh-gate second evaluation of two independent support rows minus fresh-gate second evaluation of primary support only
paired_comparators.same_id_score_and_decision_delta: fresh-gate second evaluation after exact redelivery minus primary-support-only replay
paired_comparators.correlated_group_delta: independent group count after distinct correlated support minus primary-support-only replay
paired_comparators.contradiction_score_delta: fresh-gate second evaluation of two independent supports plus contradiction minus two-independent-support baseline
paired_comparators.remove_restore: fresh-gate two-evaluation replays of baseline, removed, and restored immutable ledger states

primary_metrics.raw_expected_fields: G1 rows use expected_case_table; G0 and no-coalition rows always expect ignited, reason ignited, winner hypothesis-alpha
primary_metrics.false_ignition_population: the nine expected_no_ignition case primary rows for each condition and seed
primary_metrics.covered_accuracy_expected_winner: hypothesis-alpha for every case; no-ignition rows enter the denominator only when a condition actually ignites
primary_metrics.bootstrap_rng: one random.Random(4314), effects processed in the listed order, 10000 paired resamples per effect

raw_artifact_contract.sort_key: condition order, seed, case_index, stage order, evaluation_index

manifest_contract.runner_preflight: verify protocol bytes/hash, accepted C12/C13 merges, source pin and source diff scope, fixed-logit hash, five fixture hashes, and all protected hashes before calculation or staging writes
manifest_contract.source_pin_procedure: after source and focused tests are committed, add a separate preregistration amendment with the full source commit and set runner_execution_allowed true before the first runner execution

stop_conditions: G1 output is copied from probability confidence
threshold, weight, seed, fixture, or reason priority changes after any result
no-coalition ablation leaves every preregistered decision unchanged
fixed logits differ between paired interventions
raw rows, failed seeds, counterexamples, or no-ignition reasons are omitted
C06 or C08 negative findings, package 0.2.1, schema 0.2, release metadata, or protected hashes change
